scope: Complete seven-run, 21-catalogue campaign; representative scientific and layout review of the final 29-slide deck and 18-page figure PDF.

prior_full_render_inspection.scope: Title, IC explanation, main z=0 diagnostics, interpretation, costs and limitations inspected before the final axis/table-spacing fixes; changed content was rechecked in the final render.

findings: Scientific axes, units, resolution cuts, uncertainty shading, legends and footers are readable on the inspected pages.
The first full review identified clipped absolute velocity differences from an upper limit of 1. Final plots scale both absolute velocity and centre-distance axes to the data.
All 18 affected axes additionally pass the numeric plot-controls.json coverage checks.
z=0 passing mass ranges and higher-redshift timestep limitations agree with the completed assessments.
The first-order IC exception and the unexercised production host-violation branch remain explicit.
Automated checks report 29 slide pages and no LaTeX layout warnings; visual inspection is representative, not a claim to have inspected every page.

previous_reviews.scope: Preliminary 8-catalogue analysis only; a later full render requires a new visual review.
findings: Title and matrix are readable and identify the incomplete campaign.
Scientific panels, tick labels, legends and footers are readable without overlap or clipping after spacing corrections.
Particle floors, unresolved Vmax and the reference convention are stated.
Working ranges are descriptive and limitations remain explicit.
